item.title: Jesus Our Advocate, Standing Against the Accuser
item.description: Jesus is our Advocate, standing against every accusation of the enemy. Learn how Christ intercedes for believers and guards us from shame and fear.

item.title: Life Within the Restored City: A Study of Nehemiah 11
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Nehemiah 11, focusing on faithful living, leadership, and worship within the restored city as God places His people for His purposes.

item.title: The Incarnation and the Christian Worldview
item.description: The Incarnation is not merely a Christmas doctrine but the foundation of the Christian worldview. In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explains how the Word becoming flesh shapes our understanding of humanity, creation, truth, ethics, salvation, and hope in a confused age.

item.title: The Transforming Power of Grace: How the Gospel Changes Us
item.description: Grace does more than forgive—it transforms. In this episode of Anchored in the Word, Dave Jenkins explains from Titus 2 how the gospel saves, trains, and sustains believers for holy living.

item.title: The Armor of God, A Biblical Response to NAR Teachings
item.description: In this episode of NAR to Christ, Dawn Hill examines Ephesians 6:10–18 and contrasts biblical teaching on the Armor of God with common errors found in deliverance and NAR-influenced practices. This Christ-centered discussion emphasizes Scripture, sound doctrine, and the finished work of Christ rather than ritualistic or declarative prayer practices.

item.title: Dedication and Joyful Worship: Understanding Nehemiah 12
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Nehemiah 12, focusing on the dedication of Jerusalem’s wall and the joyful worship of God’s people. This passage highlights the importance of dedicating our work to the Lord, celebrating His faithfulness, and offering lives of joyful, Christ-centered worship.
